scope: FACT: frozen legacy source formula transcription; not source certification, artifact replay, or a new executable Axiom recipe.
window_sessions_definition: Total prior daily-panel observations needed for the complete finite-window dependency closure, excluding current row. This is not min_periods, not a claim that legacy rows are dense exchange sessions, and not a bound on prior publication-event history. null means no fixed proven session bound.
lag_sessions_definition: Explicit additional shift of the completed feature beyond its stated formula, 0 in this map. Formula-internal shifts are in formula/window_sessions. Source-publication delays and decision snapshot delays remain separate.
common_source_notes: Native monetary units, price-adjustment basis, actual consumed source artifacts and revision visibility are not independently certified by this transcription.
Legacy research adapter get_features call omits margin_lag_sessions and therefore uses default 0; financial_rc live configuration separately pins a whole feature snapshot lag of 1.
Adapter pads 1461 calendar days; a lag of 756 observations needs current plus 756 prior rows and dense-calendar evidence.
Legacy shareholder and growth loaders perform external I/O; Axiom Core must instead consume registered facts or frozen pure-computation plugins.
Legacy daily/yoy pct_change calls without fill_method inherit frozen pandas defaults; do not silently substitute explicit fill_method=None.
